headline: EPS swings to a profit both sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: LG Chem reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩1,504, swinging from a ₩4,449 per-share loss q/q and a ₩5,549 per-share loss a year earlier.
summary_long: EPS of ₩1,504 swung from a ₩4,449 per-share loss last quarter and a ₩5,549 per-share loss a year earlier. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
